author: Danyon Talbott
text: Quick, friendly service! Was at our house pumping the septic the morning after we requested service. Called when he was on his way and accepted Venmo payment. Highly recommend!

author: Kate Miller
text: Excellent experience. Easy to schedule, no major issues with availability, and mindful of your property. The tech came out to complete a routine septic cleaning and was very friendly answering my son's questions as we watched out of curiosity. We will be suing A Royal Flush for our next routine cleaning and other septic service needs.

author: John Walbridge
text:
Excellent experience. Called for a basic septic service, they called ahead of time, arrived on time, did what they promised, and charged a very reasonable fee for their service. It's not hard to see why this company has been around for so long!

My wife also enjoyed meeting Willie!

author: Lisa
text: Great service, friendly people, fair price. Would recommend to my family and friends and will call them in the future when I need the septic tank pumped again. Thank you Royal Flush!

author: Julie Ann
text: Very professional from the first phone call. Quick response and easy to schedule. I really appreciate that it is truly a family run business! Fairly priced services and very kind employees. Brian and Chris finished work very quickly and thoroughly. They answered all of my questions and were very kind, caring, and professional. It was clear they take pride in their work and strive to provide top notch services! Highly recommend and will use again in the future!
